description:
Priority: P2 (CI, OPTIONAL). Files: openapi.json (new), .github/workflows/on-push.yml. Reference: keystore/metricstore.

Problem: The template only validates that the OpenAPI spec generates; it does not catch an out-of-date committed spec. Policy decision first: aviary gitignores openapi.json and only checks generation, so committing it is a deliberate choice.

Change (if adopting): Commit openapi.json, and in generate-openapi add `git diff --exit-code openapi.json` with a helpful "run cargo make generate-openapi" error message.

Acceptance: a stale committed openapi.json fails the PR check.
title: [TPL-022] (optional) Commit openapi.json and add a drift check
